title: A member of two roles sees what either role lets through

source.quote: A user can belong to multiple roles, and the roles are additive.
source.supports: the rows of both roles are visible

source.quote: we browse the model while impersonating a user with two roles, Australia and Europe.
source.supports: SQLBI's example of a user with two continent roles sees both continents

derivation: Europe keeps Ann and Bob, Asia keeps Cy: three customers. Their sales: 130 + 50 = 180.
